dict.string: Nodemind listens to your voice so you can brain-dump. Audio is transcribed entirely on your Mac — it never leaves this device.
In meeting mode, Nodemind records the call audio playing on this Mac so your notes include what others said. It is transcribed on your Mac and never leaves this device.
Nodemind reads today's calendar to plan your day around your meetings. It never changes your calendar.
